candidate.answerReason: Rays incident parallel to the axis of a paraboloidal reflector converge at its focus after reflection.

methods.explanation: Light rays parallel to the axis of a paraboloidal reflector converge at its focus after reflection. This optical property is used in searchlights and antennas. Therefore the answer is D, the focus.
